title: Interactive Gambling Amendment (Know Your Losses Activity Statement) Bill 2025
short_title: Interactive Gambling Amendment (Know Your Losses Activity Statement) Bill 2025

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would require online gambling services to always show users their account activity statements, including net wins and losses, during wagering.
It would mandate that this information be displayed on websites and apps at all times while a user is betting, rather than requiring them to seek it out.
A six-month transition period is proposed to allow operators and customers to adjust to the new requirements.
changes: Requires regulated interactive gambling services to display account activity statements to users during wagering.
Provides a six-month implementation period for operators to update systems and processes.
Allows for engagement with operators, peak bodies, and advocates on regulations specifying the information to be displayed.
summary.affected: Australians who use regulated interactive gambling services and the operators of those services.
